title: Execution Profile
purpose: Defines the atomic execution profile mode selector for the initializer.

normative_requirements.text: An execution profile shall be an atomic mode selector that governs whether the initializer performs a dry-run validation pass, an actual generation pass with destination mutation, or a recovery pass that resumes from a preserved staging state.
The execution profile shall reject execution modes that are not supported for the given combination of request inputs, destination state, and source revision.

The execution profile shall map each supported combination of execution mode and request parameters to exactly one Level 3 initialization workflow, and the initializer shall select the corresponding workflow before performing any generation, validation, or destination mutation work.

The initializer shall reject any combination of execution profile and request parameters that maps to no supported Level 3 workflow, and shall report the reason for rejection without performing partial initialization.
